about_the_game:
High-end vs Low-end build in GOALS
When you launch GOALS from Steam, the game automatically picks the best version for your PC using our Headless Launcher. This ensures you get the smoothest possible experience - no setup needed.

High-end build (Experience)
This version is for players with powerful gaming PCs. It uses DirectX 12 and the latest Shader Model 6 (SM6) to deliver advanced graphics and more visual features. You can also fine-tune your settings for the best visual experience.

Low-end build (Performance)
Designed for older or less powerful computers, this version is optimized for lower memory use and simpler visuals. It prioritizes smooth performance, even on integrated GPUs, but doesn’t include all the visual enhancements of the High-End version.

How it works
The game automatically chooses the right version based on your hardware, including:

  • GPU type (dedicated vs integrated)

  • Available VRAM

  • CPU capabilities (instruction sets)

No need to choose manually—we’ve got you covered so you can focus on playing.
